title: Photosynthesis
subtitle: Light energy converted into chemical energy in glucose

stages.title: Light absorption
stages.summary: Chlorophyll in chloroplasts absorbs light energy for the reaction.

stages.title: Carbon dioxide & water
stages.summary: Carbon dioxide from the air and water from the soil enter the leaf.

stages.title: Glucose production
stages.summary: Light energy drives reactions that build glucose (a sugar).

stages.title: Oxygen release
stages.summary: Oxygen is released as a by-product — used in aerobic respiration.
